game.title: Resident Evil 0 / Biohazard 0 HD REMASTER
game.blurb: HD remaster of the survival horror game Resident Evil 0, from Capcom, released 2016-01-18. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters follow the five areas named in the hidden Steam achievements, plus themed chapters.

chapters.title: Files, Keys, Weapons and Herbs

chapters.title: Challenge Runs and Extra Modes
chapters.summary: Rank S, Hard difficulty, no-save and no-healing runs, and hidden achievements that look tied to the Leech Hunter and Wesker Mode extras.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 339340)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Resident_Evil_Zero
Fandom (residentevil.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://residentevil.fandom.com/wiki/Resident_Evil_0
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 339340 is listed in the store as "Resident Evil 0" and named "Resident Evil 0 / biohazard 0 HD Remaster" in its schema, so it is the HD remaster itself; there is no other Resident Evil 0 app in the store list. RAWG's first result is the expected entry (slug resident-evil-0); RAWG keeps the 2002 game ("Resident Evil Zero") and a newer "RESIDENT EVIL 0" entry separately. 28 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden. Five of them are named for finishing an area (Train, Training Facility, Laboratory, Factory, Treatment Plant) and give the area chapters, in Steam list order; StrategyWiki's contents list has the same five areas in the same order. Three hidden ones are named for leeches or "Team Wesker" and were put with the extras because residentevil.fandom.com has pages named "Leech Hunter" and "Wesker Mode"; that link is a guess from the names. The other 20 hidden ones sit in Bosses and Hidden Moments. StrategyWiki redirects "Resident Evil 0" to "Resident Evil Zero" (completion stage 0): only Characters, Table of Contents and the first area page ("The Ecliptic Express") are written; the other area, item and file pages are linked but not written, so it was not used. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil 0" with about 92 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
